newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firms amid very tight prompt supplies.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firms amid very tight prompt supplies.

text.p: NWE gasoline was stronger on Monday as tight prompt availabilities ensured strong numbers.
A eurograde barge loading today sold at $203.50 fob for the balance of July while comparable first half August material would be able to attract only $197.00.
"Its very tight with little seen before August 1-10, but it doesn't get really better (on the supply side) until August 10-20," said one dealer.

August swaps were pegged around $200.00, up $1.00 from Friday with trades concluded at $198.50 and $199.50 during the course of the day. September was backwardated by $7-8 with the October/November spread put around $5-6.
The Mediterranean remains strong at about a $4.00 a tonne premium on the backing of continued West African buying interest.
